    Summary method for 'srocsa' objects

    summary.srocsa.Rd

    This function summarizes the results: the main results (see print.srocsa) and the estimates of all the parameters (par.all) of the fitted models at each time point and each marginal selection probability \(p\). All the elements of the fitted models are kept in blocks of the returned object.

    # S3 method for class 'srocsa'
summary(object, digits = 3, ...)

    Arguments

    object

    A fitted object returned by the function srocsa.t, tsroc, or tsrocsa.lrt.

    digits

    The digits of the results

    ...

    Other arguments in function summary

    Value

    A list that consists of summaries of a srocsa object: call, type of the model, table of SAUC estimates (sauc), table of parameter estimates and SE (coef), and the fitted models at each time point and each \(p\) (blocks)

    See also

    srocsa.t, hattori.tsroc, tsrocsa.lrt, print.srocsa, print.summary.srocsa

    Examples

    ## load data
data(IVD)

fit1 <- srocsa.t(TP = TP, FN = FN, TN = TN, FP = FP, data = IVD, sa.p = c(1, 0.8, 0.6))
summary(fit1)
#> Input:
#> srocsa.t(TP = TP, FN = FN, TN = TN, FP = FP, data = IVD, sa.p = c(1, 
#>     0.8, 0.6))
